sources.role: Independent VIEWPORT field/reference inventory: frozen layer331, conditional clip340, UCS345/346/79, shade170/333, rendering/light references and scalar types. Unknown layer-override and legacy aliases remain unqualified.
Original entity identity/owner/common/application/XDATA roles remain distinct from viewport body fields; omit/default/native semantics are not invented.

scope: Reuse actual ENTITIES/BLOCKS physical/delivery/context/namespace evidence for selected original VIEWPORT producer/body/profile/target joins. Add exact typed-publication identity and original pre-staging common state, independent source fields/references and LAYOUT last-active paper-space owner checks. This does not certify recursive/live/emitted/native or external semantics.

implementation.publication: Internal reader-owned DxfViewportPublication plus borrowed getDxfViewportSourceView, available only during the actual callback. BLOCKS preserves original pre-copy state across existing deferred delivery, publishes the actual staged callback value and retains no expired parser pointer. RAII restores state on return/throw. No additional callback, source/raw copy, facade/model data member or existing DRW_Interface vtable slot.
implementation.body: Shared dxfCompound decoder preserves existing ordinary VIEWPORT parsing/validation. Original capture requires exact model identity, concrete dynamic type and scope. Bounded replay compares all public viewport/base entity/point fields, vectors, strings, references and legacy/private frozen count/provenance. Original pre-copy pending state is separate from copied models.
implementation.profile: Independent original scalar/subclass inventory admits documented modeled fields with exact types, full selected coordinate tuples, finite values, known status bits/modes and repeated frozen-layer references. Common/application/XDATA fields remain distinct. Unknown fields, noncanonical Boolean2, incomplete points and omitted required source fields cannot qualify.
implementation.references: Distinct frozen-layer331, clipping340, UCS345/346, background332, shade333, visual-style348 and sun361 roles. Original frozen-layer targets require real original LAYER providers; UCS uses real original UCS providers. Shade rows retain original170 span/value. LAYOUT331 requires an actual matched original paper-space VIEWPORT from the same original LAYOUT. Missing target bodies remain unavailable rather than manufacturing owner evidence.
implementation.booleanFix: A rich original292 witness had matching typed replay but failed source profile: recordView did not map reader BOOL to Integer, causing physical/identity observations to carry the previous string. Add BOOL to the Integer case; ordinary bool parsing/lexical acceptance is unchanged. True/false ASCII LF/CRLF/binary source fields are checked independently.
implementation.bounds: Enforce the already-existing512 frozen-layer reader cap before reserve/append, not only at final validation. Reuse existing retained record/byte/work and replay budgets with no cap increase; queries remain allocation-free. The source inventory bound also512 is not a file-format maximum.
implementation.compatibility: Existing callback order and staged BLOCKS delivery are retained. Legacy resource/table/view/UCS getters do not claim viewport publications. Correct stale public field-code comments without changing layout. Original Debug/O0 ASan configuration remains unchanged.

controls.fixturePolicy: All new inputs are authored at runtime from C++ recipes; no external DWG/DXF payload, conversion or derivative is committed.

retainedFailures: The initial richer VIEWPORT body matched modeled replay but failed original scalar admission at292. Inspect original type: STRING carrying stale text. Correct the shared BOOL observation case, rather than normalizing the source profile.

An older LAYOUT refusal now reports WrongOwner instead of OriginalUnavailable. Source inspection confirms a complete actual model-space VIEWPORT body (including30), whose original owner cannot satisfy a last-active paper-space reference. Keep this stronger reason and all existing controls/counters.
Harden the new LAYOUT join so a missing original target node remains OriginalUnavailable before paper/layout owner checks; an absent source cannot invent an owner mismatch.
